conventions.tiers: C = lowest (初阶/基础/见习/蓄电池), B = mid (高阶/进阶/正式/电源), A = top (认证章 A-name / 特化 / 资深 / 能源模块), S = boss/special items
conventions.c_equivalent: Crafting is 3 lower -> 1 higher, so 1 B = 3 C and 1 A = 9 C in C-equivalents
conventions.amount_fields: null means no source found; see 'uncertain' list for single-source or derived numbers
conventions.confidence: confirmed = 2+ independent sources agree; single_source = one source only; derived = computed from a source's totals, not stated directly; inferred = name/semantic mapping, not stated by a source

battery.overflow: Manual refills can push above 240; natural regen pauses until back under 240.

backup_battery.gain_rule: While Battery Charge is at the 240 cap, gain 1 Backup Battery Charge every 18 minutes (80 per full day at cap)
backup_battery.confidence: confirmed (3 third-party sources; no official page read)

cost.note: Before Inter-Knot Lv 30 the preset lineup is 3 cards (60 battery); at Lv 30+ up to 5 cards (100). OneDragon card_num = 默认数量 / 1张卡片..5张卡片, estimated cost card_num x 20.

missions.note: No source states per-card drops. The TapTap 2024-08 guide (highest stage) plans Agent 1->60 (900,000 EXP) as 36 runs x 2 EXP cards = 72 cards, implying ~12,500 EXP per card; it also says it averaged '3-4 A and 3-4 B' drops as 3.5, which gives 3.5x3000 + 3.5x600 = 12,600. Treat both as estimates.
TapTap guide plans S W-Engine 1->60 (600,000 EXP) as 19 runs x 2 EXP cards = 38 cards, implying ~15,800 EXP per card (only valid if EXP was the limiting resource). Per-tier counts not found.

TapTap guide: core skill dennies (405,000) = 4 runs x 5 denny cards (20 cards) -> ~20,250/card; one skill 1->12 (500,000) uses 22 denny cards -> ~22,700/card; S W-Engine (400,000) uses 19 -> ~21,050/card. Game8 says '~30,000+ per clear' at the LOWEST level without saying how many cards. Use ~20,000-22,700 per card at max level as an estimate.

sub_modes.note: Game8 (agent material pages, 2026): 'a total of 5 A Rank Certification Seals and 5-10 B Rank Certification Seals when you add five cards' -> per card 1 A + 1-2 B. C seals may also drop (not quantified).

card_num.meaning: Number of enemy cards per 实战模拟室 run. Each card costs 20 battery and drops its own rewards, so more cards = more battery and more drops per run. 默认数量 keeps the in-game default and is pre-estimated as 20 battery.

double_reward.meaning: Opt-in check for the 实战模拟室 double-drop event (数据悬赏). On the first compendium visit of a run it opens 实战模拟室, looks for the '每日怪物卡双倍掉落次数' text and OCRs the remaining count (expects 'N/5'). If any remain, it inserts a one-off temp plan using combat_simulation_double_reward_config with card_num = min(current battery // 20, remaining). It is not written to the plan list. Drive-disc (Area Patrol) doubles are deliberately not handled.
